beats.text: Wren's coin over my bread, eh? Well. I'll say no more about it.
Bright day for a stranger to wander in.
Nobody walks out here this late.

passing: Passing through, is it? Then you've picked a strange road.

passing.text: Strange things sleep in these hills. Old places, older than the village.

choices.text: Any errands that don't involve dying?

trouble: Trouble, eh? Aye, I know where it sleeps.

trouble.text: I can't go myself. I've a wife and a field to mind. But you... you look like you can swing that sword.

reward: Ha! Straight to it. Fair enough.
Fresh bread every morning for a month, and the best bed in the village. It isn't gold, but it's honest.

text: Let me {~consider}... my grandfather used to whisper about a place.
Hold on, now. There was a traveler who mentioned somewhere worth your while.

found.text: It's about {distance} blocks to the {direction}, out in the {biome|wilds}.

text: The ones who came back described {look}.
{boss} sleeps there, {danger}. Nobody who went to face it has come home to complain.
Something old and terrible waits inside: {boss}, {danger}. I'd not send my worst enemy.
{boss} guards the place, {danger}. Bring enough steel for two.
They call the thing inside {boss}: {danger}, and mean.
{boss} dwells there, {danger}. A hard fight, but a fair one.
It's {boss} in there, {danger}. Bring your wits.

found.text: Something dwells there. I {~uncertainty} what it is.

nothing: Hm. Odd... I can't think of anywhere left within a week's walk that I haven't already told you about.
You've likely seen more of this land than I have.

accepted.text: Then may your blade stay sharp.

accepted: Come back and tell me how it went. I'll keep the porch light burning.
postponed: Aye. The dark will keep, I suppose. It just won't get any shorter.
dismissed: Right. Well. The road's that way, and it's a long one.
threat: ...Ah. A hard one. Well, I've a pitchfork and a very long memory.

text: Errands? Aye, a few. What sort do you fancy?
Fetch-and-carry, or something sharper? I've both.

choices.text: The old shrine in the desert.

courier.text: Let me see... there's a letter that's been sitting on my shelf.

courier_found: It's for the innkeeper in another village, past the {structure}: {distance} blocks to the {direction}.
There's a village called the {structure}, {distance} blocks {direction}, and a second beyond it.
Stop at the first, then find the second. The innkeeper is expecting you.

courier_found.text: It isn't dangerous, and it pays honest coin. Will you carry it?

courier_accepted: Keep the seal unbroken, and keep to the roads. Come back when it's delivered.
shrine: The desert shrine, eh? Kobolds raid my fields from it. I want it broken, and the champion with it.
There's an old shrine in the desert. Wren calls it history; I call it a nuisance.

shrine.text: It'll take steel. Shall I point the way?

shrine_found: It's {distance} blocks to the {direction}, out in the {biome|sand}.

shrine_found.text: {boss} keeps it, {danger|and no one has faced it}.
Bread and my thanks if you break it. Will you {~set_out}?

shrine_accepted: Then come back when the wheat's safe. I'll heat the oven.
